_comment: Third-party network entity -> Shopify app -> fix route. Used by merge_findings.py to attribute Lighthouse third-parties-insight rows. Matching is substring-on-hostname, most specific match wins. Seeded from ecom-a11y-audit/skills/a11y-audit/references/shopify-attribution.md, remapped from CSS selectors to script hostnames because third-parties-insight keys on network entities, not DOM.
_owner_values: theme | app | shopify | analytics | payment | unknown
_surface_values: settings (app has a config/custom-CSS field that can reach it) | vendor (only the vendor can change it) | theme (merchant controls the embed) | none

first_party.route: Assets served from the theme. Oversized JS/CSS bundles and unoptimized images here are theme-owned and fixable in Liquid.
first_party.perf_notes: A large cdn.shopify.com JS payload is almost always the theme's own bundle or an app block's asset copied into the theme. Check assets/ before blaming an app.

first_party.route: Shopify-owned telemetry and platform scripts. Not removable. Report as fixed overhead, never as an action item.
first_party.perf_notes: Web Pixels and Shop Pay. Counts against TBT but is not merchant-actionable.

apps.route: Rebuy admin > Smart Cart and widget settings. Custom CSS/JS fields can reach styling but not the bundle. Reduce enabled widgets per template before escalating to Rebuy support.
apps.perf_notes: Large bundle plus per-widget API fetches. Commonly the biggest third-party blocking chunk on PDP and cart. Each additional widget is another render pass.

apps.route: Okendo admin > widget settings. Defer the reviews widget below the fold; the star-rating snippet can stay above.
apps.perf_notes: Review media grids are a frequent LCP and CLS source when rendered above the fold without reserved space.

apps.route: Klaviyo > Signup Forms for popup timing. The onsite tracking script is embedded by the Klaviyo app block; delay non-critical forms rather than removing tracking.
apps.perf_notes: klaviyo.js plus form bundles. Popups that mount above the fold are a classic CLS culprit. Per-device visibility settings exist and are often misconfigured.

apps.route: Judge.me admin > widget settings; lazy-load option exists. Widget placement is controlled by the theme app block.
apps.perf_notes: Review widget loads its own CSS. Reserve height in the theme to avoid CLS on hydration.

apps.route: Loox admin > display settings. Photo review galleries should be below the fold.
apps.perf_notes: Image-heavy galleries. A Loox photo above the fold will win LCP and it will be slow.

apps.route: Yotpo admin. Loyalty and Reviews ship separate bundles; audit whether both are needed on every template.
apps.perf_notes: Historically one of the heaviest review bundles. Check whether it loads on collection pages where it is rarely needed.

apps.route: Stamped admin > widget settings.
apps.perf_notes: Similar profile to Judge.me. Reserve widget height in theme.

apps.route: Privy admin > campaign timing. Delay display until after LCP.
apps.perf_notes: Popup mount is a CLS and INP source. Trigger on scroll or delay, never immediately.

apps.route: Attentive admin > creative settings. Script is embedded via app block or theme.liquid; confirm which before editing.
apps.perf_notes: Often injected directly into theme.liquid head by a past install. If so, ownership is theme and it can be moved to defer.

apps.route: Postscript admin. Same head-injection caveat as Attentive.
Recharge admin. Widget only belongs on subscription-eligible PDPs; check it is not loading store-wide.
apps.perf_notes: Subscription widget hydration shifts the PDP buy box. Reserve space.

apps.route: Gorgias admin > chat settings. Enable deferred loading so the launcher mounts after page load.
apps.perf_notes: Chat launchers are pure post-load cost when deferred, and a large TBT hit when not.

apps.route: Tidio admin > chat display settings.
Swym admin. Wishlist buttons on collection grids multiply per-card JS cost.
Smile admin > launcher settings. Defer launcher.
apps.perf_notes: Fixed-position launcher, loads on every template including checkout-adjacent pages.

apps.route: Nosto admin. Recommendation slots render client-side; reserve height to avoid CLS.
apps.perf_notes: Being migrated away from on some stores in favor of native search. Check whether it is still needed before optimizing it.

apps.route: Algolia dashboard plus the theme's InstantSearch embed. The embed is usually theme code, so partial theme ownership.
Boost admin. Collection filter hydration is a common collection-page CLS source.
Searchanise admin.
Convermax admin. Fitment selectors above the fold block interaction; measure INP with the selector in view.
Fix route is the Shogun editor, not the theme. Pages built here are outside theme code entirely.
apps.perf_notes: Builder pages commonly ship unoptimized hero images and inline styles. Theme-side fixes will not apply.

apps.route: PageFly editor. Same caveat as Shogun.
GemPages editor. Same caveat as Shogun.
LoyaltyLion admin.
Triple Whale pixel settings. Attribution pixels are a business decision, not purely a perf one; report cost and let the merchant weigh it.
Elevar admin / GTM container.
Fera admin.
Vitals admin. It bundles dozens of features behind one script; disabling unused modules is the highest-leverage fix.
apps.perf_notes: A single Vitals install can account for most third-party JS on a store. Audit which of its modules are actually in use.

apps.route: Tapcart admin. Should not be loading on the web storefront at all in most configurations.
Bold admin. Legacy Bold installs often leave theme snippets behind after uninstall; grep the theme for bold- before assuming app ownership.
Wisepops admin > campaign timing.
Justuno admin > campaign timing.
Ad pixel. Negligible perf cost; do not spend a finding on it unless it is blocking.
TrustedSite admin, or uninstall. A floating trust badge is rarely worth its main-thread cost; measure the conversion claim against the measured delay before keeping it.
apps.perf_notes: Lighthouse's third-party-web database misattributes cdn.ywxi.net to 'Tencent'. Match on the hostname, not the reported entity name. Observed at 481ms main thread on a live store, the single largest third-party cost on that page.

apps.route: Rise.ai admin. Widget only needs to load on cart, checkout-adjacent and account pages, not store-wide.
VerifyPass admin. Only needed on pages offering the gated discount; store-wide loading is usually a misconfiguration.
DailyKarma admin. Cart-scoped in most configurations.
Instant editor. Builder-owned pages are outside theme code; theme-side fixes will not apply.
apps.perf_notes: Ships a large bundle with long cache-lifetime problems. Observed at 266KB with 181KB of it re-fetched due to short max-age.

apps.route: Alia app settings. Delay load until after page render; compress popup creative (a 210KB popup image observed on one store). Backend at backend.alia-prod.com.
apps.perf_notes: Observed 532ms main thread + 691KB on a store PDP 2026-08-18.

apps.route: Vendor ticket or app removal. pscript.js loads synchronously in head (render-blocking ~1s under throttle) and the snippet injects a literal second <title>Paramount Pixel</title> into every page. Confirm the pixel is still in use before anything else.
apps.perf_notes: Identified on one store 2026-08-18 by the adjacent qbit('event','site_visit') inline snippet.

apps.route: Triple Whale app. api.config-security.com is their pixel endpoint (preconnect injected by the triple_pixel_snippet app block).
Black Crow AI app embed (shopify-init.blackcrow.ai loader). Async already; cost is usually small.
GovX ID app settings; loader at id-shop.govx.com. Small footprint.
Unidentified. Injected via Shopify script tag on one store (loader.js?g_cvt_id=...&shop=...). Identify the owning app in the store admin before recommending anything.

analytics_and_payment.route: GTM container. The container itself is cheap; its tags are not. Audit tag count and firing triggers in GTM, not in the theme.
analytics_and_payment.perf_notes: GTM is frequently blamed for cost that belongs to the tags inside it. Name the tags before recommending removal.

analytics_and_payment.route: Shopify > Settings > Customer events, or the Meta sales channel. Prefer the server-side Conversions API where the merchant already has it.
TikTok sales channel or Customer events.
Clarity project settings. Session recording has real INP cost; sample rather than record everything.
Hotjar site settings. Same sampling advice as Clarity.
Payment messaging widget. Usually low priority and not merchant-actionable.
Express checkout buttons. Shopify-managed on most plans; not merchant-actionable.
